scope: Same frozen final raw checkpoints, 108 fixed strong-augmented train images, CPU FP32, no parameter updates
reference_mask: Original ROI model assignment for every comparison
limitations: Auxiliary classification probe is not detection AP.
Same reference GT groups are used, rather than comparing independently selected groups.
Converged weights do not identify early-training mechanisms.
Split probe reconstructs the all-GT auxiliary readout; unmatched gradient norms in its raw report are hypothetical, not the gated training gradients.
